description_zh: Cruise AV 直行，对向 BMW 突然越线侵入其车道，导致碰撞（选 Cruise AV 为 ego，测其对突然侵入的应对）

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle ("Cruise AV"), operating in supervised autonomous mode, was traveling westbound on Brannan Street...
At the same time, a black BMW traveling eastbound on Brannan Street swerved into oncoming traffic and in front of the Cruise AV.
contact was made with the Cruise AV's front right quarter panel
evidence.reason: BMW swerved into oncoming traffic 对应 vehicle/oncoming 行为，Cruise AV 正常直行，可构成 oncoming 冲突场景。无量化速度，不填参数。天气与照明根据时间推断为 morning，weather 无描述。
